claims.excerpt: reduce wrinkles by 90% in two weeks
claims.claim_text: Claim that the product reduces wrinkles by 90% in two weeks.
claims.explanation: There is no fact in the knowledge base supporting a 90% reduction in wrinkles in two weeks. FACT-001 mentions skin hydration improvement in 4 weeks across 94% of tested subjects, but nothing regarding 90% wrinkle reduction.

notes.excerpt: Our concentrate is clinically proven to reduce wrinkles by 90% in two weeks.
notes.note: Ensure product is designated as 'Lumo Glow Concentrate' per TERM-001 if this is the primary hydration treatment.
